verdict.rationale: Fly.io states that it converts Docker images into fast-booting VMs and runs them globally. It also documents `fly launch` and `fly machine run` for building and deploying apps, and `fly doctor` explicitly checks Docker. One community report says container pushes failed 70-80% of the time, and another describes stuck deploys; these are reliability complaints rather than evidence the capability is absent, so they lower confidence instead of making the verdict disputed. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on Dockerfile or prebuilt-registry image deploys, consistent independent corroboration of reliable container deploys.
